Just to be sure:

Minion A takes an action,
Minion B blocks,
Resulting combat.
It is now too late to play Mask of 1,000 Faces, right? "After combat" is
still the action resolution phase?

--Gor

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It is too late. Mask cannot be played after/during the resolution of the action.
